hooks.command: file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$file" in */dist/*|dist/*) echo 'dist/ is generated output — do not hand-edit it. Change canonical/<block>.md or platforms/<name>/recipe.json, then run: npm run build' >&2; exit 2;; *) exit 0;; esac

file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$file" in *canonical/*|*platforms/*) npm run build >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo 'Rebuilt dist/ from canonical/recipes. Snapshots are now stale — run: npm test -- -u to re-bless before committing.' >&2; exit 2;; *) exit 0;; esac
